title: 第134章 褔陀啊褔陀你说你惹它干什么第133章 一人压一宗
content_zh:
第一卷第134章褔陀啊褔陀，你说你惹它干什么……
这天，莲台仙宗众人总算见识到了人道圣人二弟子手中，那件闻名已久，由圣人亲手炼制的后天极品灵宝‘阴阳镯’的威能。
宗中所有人引以为傲的护山大阵，在那阴阳镯的下压威势下，没撑过两个呼吸，瞬间碎成了渣。
陆地上空的尘埃尚未散去，宛如仙境的宗门毁于一旦，高楼庙宇十不存一。
就连连接地脉的阵法也被破坏，各类阵法全部瘫痪。
此时，造成这一结果的始作俑者，已带着众人在回东海的路上……
莲尘世尊悬在高空中，看着这一幕出神。
莲台仙宗众长老群情激奋，大声喝骂陈椽锡，批判他的暴行。
陆地深处，一座大殿的废墟上，净华脸上尽是悲悯，神情有些呆滞。
褔陀躺靠在残垣断壁之下，眯眼看着滚滚烟尘，眼神阴鸷，不知心中所想。
莲台仙宗遭此大劫，宗中弟子死伤过半，甚至连几个长老因出手庇护宗门，受了不同程度的道伤。
就在活下来的人庆祝劫后余生时，一波未平，一波又起。
远处，高空中飞来成片的云雾，上面站着乌泱泱的一群人。
“褔驼滚出来受死！”
那群人还没到，喊声已在莲台仙宗废墟上空炸响。
“杀我万灵宗弟子，我要你们莲台仙宗……”
喊话之人一愣。
张大嘴巴看着破败的宗门，“我们是不是走错路了，这里是莲台仙宗吧？”
莲台仙宗上空出现几人，对来者怒目而视。
看到几个面熟的长老，喊话之人确定没来错地方，接着之前的话喊道：“你们真是吃了熊心豹子胆了，敢对我万灵宗弟子出手，今日不给一个说法，我等踏平你这莲台仙宗！”

莲台仙宗众长老一听顿时气不打一处来。
人道圣人弟子欺负他们也就罢了，你万灵宗算哪根葱，也敢来莲台仙宗上空叫阵，真当我宗中无人不成？
正当几个长老飞天而起，与万灵宗众人对峙，打算从他们这儿讨回点丢掉的脸面时，天空中不同的两个方向再次出现两片巨大的云雾。
依旧是人未到、声先至。
“魔道千宝混元宗前来助阵！”
“魔道截天殿前来助阵！”
云上，亦是乌泱泱一大片人。
莲台仙宗众人齐齐无言。
那几个想要出头的长老也默默退了回去。
都说魔道人人义薄云天，打架打不过就喜欢摇人，怎么宗门之间也是这般模样？
更让他们无语的还在后头。
魔道另外量大宗门的人还没飞到，后方又来了一大片云雾。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 134 Futuo, Futuo, why did you provoke it...
On this day, everyone in the Liantai Immortal Sect finally saw the power of the long-famous acquired spiritual treasure ‘Yin Yang Bracelet’, which was in the hands of the second disciple of the Saint of Humanity and was refined by the Saint himself.
The mountain-protecting formation that everyone in the sect was proud of was instantly shattered into pieces under the pressure of the Yin-Yang Bracelet, which could not last more than two breaths.
The dust over the land has not yet dispersed. The fairyland-like sects were destroyed and not a single tall building or temple remained.
Even the formations connecting the earth veins were destroyed, and all types of formations were paralyzed.
At this time, the person who caused this result was already leading everyone on their way back to the East China Sea...
Lord Lianchen was hanging high in the sky, watching this scene in trance.
The elders of the Liantai Immortal Sect were excited and shouted loudly at Chen Chengxi, criticizing his atrocities.
Deep in the land, on the ruins of a great hall, Jinghua's face was filled with compassion and her expression was a little dull.
Fu Tuo was lying under the ruins of the wall, squinting at the billowing smoke and dust with a sinister look in his eyes, not knowing what he was thinking.
The Liantai Immortal Sect suffered such a catastrophe, and more than half of the disciples in the sect were killed or injured. Several elders even suffered varying degrees of Taoist injuries for protecting the sect.
Just as those who survived were celebrating their lives after the disaster, one wave was rising and another was rising.
In the distance, clouds and mist flew high in the sky, and a group of people stood on them.
"Get out of here and die!"
Before that group of people arrived, shouts had already exploded over the ruins of the Liantai Immortal Sect.
"Kill my Wanling Sect disciples, I want your Liantai Immortal Sect..."
The person who shouted was stunned.
He looked at the ruined sect with his mouth wide open, "Did we go the wrong way? This is the Liantai Immortal Sect, right?"
Several people appeared in the sky above the Liantai Immortal Sect, glaring at those who came.
Seeing a few familiar elders, the caller confirmed that he had come to the right place, and continued what he said before: "You are so brave that you dare to attack my Wanling Sect disciples. If you don't give me an explanation today, we will crush your Liantai Immortal Sect!"
The elders of the Liantai Immortal Sect were immediately furious when they heard this.
It’s just a matter of bullying the disciples of the human saint. Who are you from the Wanling Sect? You dare to come to the Liantai Immortal Sect to call for formation. Do you really think that no one in our sect can do it?
Just as several elders flew into the sky to confront the people of Wanling Sect, intending to regain some lost face from them, two huge clouds appeared again in two different directions in the sky.
It's still the voice that arrives before anyone arrives.
"The Demonic Thousand Treasures Hunyuan Sect is here to help!"
"Demon Dao Jie Tian Palace comes to help!"
On the clouds, there is also a large group of people in the dark sky.
Everyone in the Liantai Immortal Sect was speechless.
The few elders who wanted to come forward also retreated silently.
It is said that everyone in the Demon Dao is righteous and likes to shake people if they can't beat them in a fight. How come the sects are also like this?
What left them even more speechless was what was to come.
Before the other people from the other sects of Demon Dao arrived, another large cloud came from behind.
